goals: Verify that the web service deployed via Docker Compose is accessible and correctly maintains state across multiple requests.
activities: Initialize Docker Compose project with options
Wait for 1 second for the server to be ready
Send a GET request to the web service at http://0.0.0.0:5000/
Print the Docker Compose project attributes
Assert that the response text is 'Hello World! I have been seen 1 times.\n'
Send another GET request to the web service at http://0.0.0.0:5000/
Assert that the response text is 'Hello World! I have been seen 2 times.\n'
